The offhand slot must be non-None, unbroken, resolve a prefab with non-None/non-Bait OffHandCD and have no unelapsed running offhand cooldown.

CurrentStateAllowInteractions rejects restricted guest mode (guestMode && adminPrivileges<1), spawning/release/death/teleport and non-idle sleep; Sitting, PlayingInstrument, vehicle/mount and secondary-use slot rules follow the referenced method.

Entering starts offHandCooldownTimer from prefab CooldownCD, fallback0.5 seconds. Exact active CooldownAuthoring values are8373≈0.8s and8374≈0.6s; this cost starts before hit success. No mana/item/durability debit is present in this bounded input/Enter/StartGrapplingRoutine path.

completion:essential:grapple-input-aim-v.value: From either hook item, distinguish a usable input/aim request, cooldown rejection and NothingHit from a successful traversal; gear equip alone cannot provide that distinction.
8373:0/8374:0 offhand mechanic7 input → UseOffHand → selected aim → direct grappling request/state writes, bounded before downstream grappling movement.

value.rule: No held input, blocked interaction/state, invalid/broken/unsupported offhand or cooldown returns before push. A pressed button during cooldown records lastPressedOnCooldownTick before return; that write alone does not prove a queued retry.

NothingHit leaves hit state NothingHit and does not newly set activeRoutine=Grappling; Update requests Walk when the resulting active routine is none of Shielding/Dashing/Grappling. Failed hit still follows the timer/position/index writes and already-started cooldown.
GrapplingHook pushes UseOffHand instead of SetNextState. Enter stores selected objectID/variation and sets useGrapplingNextUpdate; Update clears the flag before invoking StartGrapplingRoutine.

Keyboard/mouse uses normalizesafe(aimDirection). Pad starts from adjustedMovementVelocity, overrides it with aimDirection when wasAiming, uses facingDirection only if resulting length is zero, then normalizes.

Request resolves stored hook prefab and mechanicValue, obtains current/history collision worlds, constructs the offset-adjusted grapplingDirection, then calls tile, world, enemy-stop and enemy-pushback helpers. These are exact direct helper calls; their full downstream behavior is outside this record.

Regardless of didHit, method starts grapplingTimer using lerp(minMaxTime, closestWalkableTileDistance/mechanicValue), writes hook position/distance/hitState and increments grapplingUseIndex. didHit sets Success or DidNotReachWallSuccess after walkable-distance comparison and permits activeRoutine=Grappling.

Completion here means the static direct request and field writes only. PlayerGrapplingRoutine travel/collision/end, helper internals, successful traversal, runtime DB/physics and network outcome are not claimed. Do not apply this mechanic7 rule to every offhand.

value.text: 입력 차단이 없으면 수평·수직 CHARACTER_MOVEMENT 축을 ProcessMovementInput에 전달한다. 크기 0.25 미만은 0, 그 외 방향은 각도별 snap table을 쓰고 해당 table 방향이 0이면 원본을 정규화한다. 크기 0.75 미만은 방향의 0.4배, 그 이상은 방향 그대로다. 입력이 차단되면 movementDirection은 0이다. tick을 설정해 ClientInputData와 최신 frame에 전달하며 MoveFaster held도 별도 버튼으로 보낸다.

movementDirection의 길이가 1보다 크면 정규화한다. 죽음·조건부 수면·특정 상태 및 비god 배치 상태면 목표 속도 0, 아니면 방향을 목표 속도로 쓴다. 상태·snare·속도 조건, 보트/탈것/안장 배율과 주변 force, warmup/windup 배율 및 코너 보정이 적용된다. godMode에서는 MoveFaster held가 유효할 때 3배, 아닐 때 1배의 별도 분기다.

Walk는 adjustedMovementVelocity에 목줄 힘과 조건부 미끄럼을 반영하고 방향 전환 지연, 장착 아이템 이동 배율, 적과 겹침 방지 힘을 계산해 PlayerMovementForceCD를 쓴다. PlayerMovementSystem은 force 길이/60의 선형 impulse를 질량에 따라 PhysicsVelocity에 적용한다. 충돌·시뮬레이션과 실제 위치는 runtime에 결정된다.
Walk의 물리 후 단계에서 목표 이동 속도 제곱이 0.01보다 클 때 tick 시작 위치와 현재 위치의 거리만큼 누적한다. 누적이 1보다 커질 때 1을 빼고 Running skill 1 요청을 보낸다. 서버·스킬 버퍼·상한 조건을 통과해야 실제 진행도가 기록된다.

공격 타이머 gate와 effectiveVelocity 길이 >1이면 Vehicle 타입 DealDamageToEntityBuffer를 추가한다. PlayerAttackSystem이 TryGoKartAttack을 호출해 플레이어 앞 반경 0.8 collider와 기본 damage 10(제어 대상이 mount면 mountDamage)을 전달한다. isGoKart 경로에서 일반 적 타격 반복은 건너뛰고 대상 entity는 파괴 가능한 물체 또는 root인지 검사한다. 타일 분기는 bigRoot에만 요청한다. 적격 물체는 피해/HP 소비자로, bigRoot는 TileDamageBuffer 소비자로 이어지며 충돌·보호·예측 gate와 실제 결과는 runtime에 달린다.
대상 파괴 또는 상호작용을 소비했고 이탈 속도 조건을 만족하면 Walk로 전환한다. ExitState는 제어 해제, 위치 보정, 이동 force 0 및 허기 소모 복구를 수행한다.

value.effect: For each NewConditionsBuffer item invoke EntityUtility.AddOrRefreshCondition with condition data, current tick/rate, condition table, and summarized conditions; afterwards clear NewConditionsBuffer. A processed queue item does not guarantee a changed ConditionsBuffer.

For same-ID entries ShouldOverrideCondition selects whether to replace based on remaining value comparison when configured or current duration <= new duration otherwise. A rejected match does not become a fresh addition. On accepted replacement, additive values may be combined and capped; nonadditive values may be adjusted by stacks; existing element is replaced with a calculated removeTick. If no matching ID exists, append a new ConditionsBuffer element with calculated removeTick.

Separately, SummarizeConditionsSystem checks chunk change versions/order and clears then recomputes summary buffers. Ordinary own conditions of a buff-owner pet are skipped except PetBuffsIncrease; valid table IDs accumulate by condition ID and mapped effect. Other contribution sources also exist. Scheduling, dependency and timing determine when a new summary is visible; no same-tick claim.

The later condition removal job considers nonpermanent finite positive durations and elapsed removeTick, marked removals, and active-effect removal. Certain stack conditions can refresh instead; it queues removal indices and RemoveConditionsJob removes them. Entity/query state, ticking, special condition branches and other removal paths apply.
